answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is proof-of-stake (PoS) with a reputation system. Each agent stakes a unique digital asset, creating a haven for honest participants. An attacker attempting to forge multiple identities would need to acquire and lock a large delta of assets, making it economically infeasible. The reputation system tracks agent behavior, penalizing malicious actors and further increasing the cost of Sybil attacks.
